edits.new:
# Hierarchical Bayesian binomial-beta model fitted with RStan
library(rstan)

setwd("/app")

dat <- read.csv("/app/data.csv")
stan_data <- list(N = nrow(dat), y = as.integer(dat$y), n = as.integer(dat$n))

model <- stan_model(file = "/app/hierarchical_model.stan")

fit <- rstan::sampling(
  object = model,
  data = stan_data,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 100000,
  seed = 1,
  cores = 4,
  refresh = 0
)

posterior <- rstan::extract(fit, pars = c("alpha", "beta"))
alpha_mean <- mean(posterior$alpha)
beta_mean <- mean(posterior$beta)

cat(sprintf("posterior mean alpha: %f\n", alpha_mean))
cat(sprintf("posterior mean beta: %f\n", beta_mean))

writeLines(format(alpha_mean, digits = 10), "/app/posterior_alpha_mean.txt")
writeLines(format(beta_mean, digits = 10), "/app/posterior_beta_mean.txt")
